'''Holo-imaging rooms''' were a form of recreational entertainment. Many holo-imaging rooms were located in the [[Sabre Club]] at the [[Ace of Sabres]], and they could be programmed to suit the needs and whims of the individual member.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
